# Ahmed Ziwar - AI Consultant | Kuwait & GCC

> AI strategy and delivery for mid-sized companies in Kuwait and the GCC. Ahmed Ziwar is a Kuwait-based digital solutions and AI integration consultant with more than 15 years across IT, digital marketing and AI delivery. He helps management teams move AI from presentations to working solutions their people adopt and results leadership can measure. Arabic and English.

## Services

- AI strategy & readiness: A clear, prioritised AI roadmap your leadership agrees on. Opportunity and use-case workshops, data and systems readiness review, prioritised roadmap with business cases, build/buy/partner recommendations.
- AI solution delivery & integration: Working AI solutions connected to the systems you already use. AI assistants and avatar experiences, document intelligence and search, process and workflow automation, secure AI model gateways.
- Adoption & enablement: Teams that use the solution and leaders who can see the impact. Rollout and change planning, team training and playbooks, usage and impact measures for management, ongoing improvement after go-live.

## Who it is for

Mid-sized companies in Kuwait and the GCC with an established management team, who value quality, clear accountability and long-term results over the lowest price.
